title: rubus koehleri subsp. spinulifer
intro: Rubus koehleri subsp. spinulifer, commonly known as a type of blackberry, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rubus koehleri subsp. spinulifer include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various gastrointestinal and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
